propositions: Canonical preview must produce one manifest containing arbitrated plan entries and exact field-level drift from a single dry-run differ pass without launching reconcile-check
Canonical preview must bypass pass-lock acquisition, purge, steal, and write operations while remaining lock-free and leaving collateral state unchanged
The argparse parser must set allow_abbrev=False to reject prefix abbreviations and unknown options with invocation error 2 before any reads, locks, or mutations
Legacy reconcile-check, reconcile --mode dry-run, reconcile --mode live, and library/MCP callers must retain their existing observable behavior, lock semantics, and output contracts unchanged
Canonical preview and canonical sync must emit the same field-comparable manifest envelope, while legacy uncapped LIVE must retain its historical tally-only no-retained-manifest surface
